title: Wild's Horizon
description: Custom lightmaps for Better than Adventure that tweak the color of torches, create cooler day to night transitions, and bath the Nether in a searing red.
body:
This asset pack for the Beta 1.7.3 fork, [Better than Adventure!](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/), tweaks the default lightmap to have a warmer, hot even (in the Nether), feel. Along with that it makes the day to night transition **feel** like a proper transition!

![Collage showing this asset pack's offerings.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5228a613adb1a3e3b61a49a149cf2bdcb933eb2d.jpeg)

# Installation
This asset pack is made for [Better than Adventure!](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/) as mentioned above and is unlikely to work at all on plain **Beta 1.7.3!**

Download this asset pack and put it in the `texturepacks` folder found within your Better than Adventure instance. The ingame Texture Packs option has a button to open this folder if you don't know where to find it.

## It Isn't Working!
Make sure you've set the Lightmap Style (found within Options -> Video -> Visual) to **Grayscale** or **Colorized**! This asset pack will not work if the lightmap is disabled.

*...Psst, You can also hit F3+L ingame to enable or disable the lightmap...*
